preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in [n, q]) and 1 <= s <= n
preconditions.description: n and q are integers between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, and s is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
Each of the q plan lines has exactly 5 space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(t) <= 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each plan type t is an integer between 1 and 3 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each plan, v is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(l) <= int(r) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) != 1)
preconditions.description: For plans of type 2 or 3, l and r are integers such that 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each plan, w (cost) is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(min_cost) for min_cost in compute_min_costs(n, q, s, stdin.splitlines()[1:])]
postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated list of n integers, where the i-th integer (1-based) is the minimum cost to reach planet i from planet s, or -1 if it is impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(min_cost == -1 or min_cost >= 0 for min_cost in map(int, stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer (minimum cost).
The output contains exactly n space-separated integers.
